targets.rawSql:
WITH module_pool AS (
  SELECT
    mod_ivtest_no,
    module_name,
    date_test,
    comment,
    rel_hum :: float,
    temp_c :: float
  FROM
    public.module_iv_test
  WHERE
    module_name LIKE '320%'
    AND status = 8
),
base_modules AS (
  SELECT
    DISTINCT module_name
  FROM
    module_pool
),
thermal1 AS (
  SELECT
    DISTINCT ON (module_name) module_name,
    mod_ivtest_no,
    date_test
  FROM
    module_pool
  WHERE
    (
      (
        rel_hum > 12
        AND temp_c > 0
      )
      OR comment = 'thermal1'
    )
  ORDER BY
    module_name,
    mod_ivtest_no DESC
),
thermal2 AS (
  SELECT
    DISTINCT ON (module_name) module_name,
    mod_ivtest_no,
    date_test
  FROM
    module_pool
  WHERE
    comment = 'thermal2'
    OR (temp_c < -20)
  ORDER BY
    module_name,
    mod_ivtest_no DESC
),
thermal3 AS (
  SELECT
    DISTINCT ON (module_name) module_name,
    mod_ivtest_no,
    date_test
  FROM
    module_pool
  WHERE
    comment = 'thermal3'
    OR (
      rel_hum < 12
      AND temp_c > 0
    )
  ORDER BY
    module_name,
    mod_ivtest_no DESC
),
qc AS (
  SELECT
    DISTINCT ON (module_name) *
  FROM
    public.module_qc_summary
  ORDER BY
    module_name, mod_qc_no DESC
),
my_module_info AS (
  SELECT
    module_name,
    TO_CHAR(assembled :: DATE, 'YY-MM-dd') AS assembled,
    TO_CHAR(inspected :: DATE, 'YY-MM-dd') AS inspected,
    TO_CHAR(wb_back :: DATE, 'YY-MM-dd') AS back_wirebond,
    TO_CHAR(encap_back :: DATE, 'YY-MM-dd') AS back_encapsulate,
    TO_CHAR(wb_front :: DATE, 'YY-MM-dd') AS front_wirebond,
    TO_CHAR(encap_front :: DATE, 'YY-MM-dd') AS front_encapsulate,
    TO_CHAR(test_ped :: DATE, 'YY-MM-dd') AS pedestal_test,
    TO_CHAR(test_iv :: DATE, 'YY-MM-dd') AS iv_curve,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY module_name
      ORDER BY
        module_no DESC
    ) AS rn
  FROM
    public.module_info
  WHERE
    module_name LIKE '320%'
)
SELECT
  t.module_name,
  t.assembled,
  t.inspected AS module_inspect,
  t.back_wirebond,
  t.back_encapsulate,
  t.front_wirebond,
  t.front_encapsulate,
  t.pedestal_test,
  t.iv_curve,
  TO_CHAR(t1.date_test :: DATE, 'YY-MM-dd') AS IV_thermal_init,
  TO_CHAR(t2.date_test :: DATE, 'YY-MM-dd') AS IV_thermal_low_temp,
  TO_CHAR(t3.date_test :: DATE, 'YY-MM-dd') AS IV_thermal_finished,
  qc.final_grade AS grade
FROM
  my_module_info AS t
  LEFT JOIN thermal1 t1 ON t.module_name = t1.module_name
  LEFT JOIN thermal2 t2 ON t.module_name = t2.module_name
  LEFT JOIN thermal3 t3 ON t.module_name = t3.module_name
  LEFT JOIN qc ON t.module_name = qc.module_name
ORDER BY
  RIGHT(t.module_name, 4) DESC;
